verdict.rationale: Superpowers is centered on delegation. Once you approve a plan, your agent runs a subagent-driven-development process, dispatching tasks to subagents, reviewing each one with a code-reviewer agent, and often working autonomously for hours (gh-10, gh-18, docs-11, docs-60). A community user confirms this brainstorm→plan→subagent-implement workflow works in practice (comm-2). The big caveat is that the assistant is not built in: Superpowers is a skills plugin, and the AI doing the work comes from a separate host harness such as Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI (gh-19, docs-13, gh-11). Missing for 10: a self-contained assistant shipped by the product itself rather than one borrowed from an external agent harness, and independent evidence on how reliable the delegated work is.
